services.name: Rentals & Catering
services.desc: Host your next gathering in the Cedar Room. Our spacious dining area comfortably seats up to 150 guests. We offer rentals all year round, but some blackout dates do apply during the Woodmen's Museum's regular season from early June to the end of August.
